title: Reliability Certification Results
methodology: Stratified random sampling, blind DCS v1.1 CL classification, 300-item mega-sample across 4 groups

control_retain.interpretation: DCS perfectly identifies genuine Apply items

treatment_downgrade.interpretation: 95% agreement with S722A reclassification — confirms stored labels were incorrect

boundary_escalate.interpretation: All escalated items have operative numbers — correctly Apply

dl012_clone_area.interpretation: 17 clones reclassified Understand — DL-012 template inflation confirmed

apply_to_understand.cause: Company names in stem without operative facts — cosmetic wrappers

dcs_v11_reliability_assessment: DCS v1.1 produces consistent, reproducible CL classifications. 62.3% rate reflects stored-label contamination, not standard unreliability. DCS independently validates 95% of S722A reclassification judgments.
